title: fix(agents): isolate optional admission diagnostics
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: an ordinary tool failure with unreadable nested diagnostics aborts the agent turn before the model can continue.

## User Impact

Agents can continue after ordinary tool errors even when optional metadata cannot be inspected. Uncertain writes and confirmed retired-admission errors still stop continuation.

## Why This Change Was Made

`d9837a55eb7` / #189008 added optional admission-error inspection outside the existing diagnostic catch. Move that inspection inside the catch while keeping canonical unknown-write detection first and outside it. The complete production delta is +4/-1 lines; tests and assertions are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Failing full run: [41172573619](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41172573619), head `8993eba475`, job `checks-node-compact-small-9`, `agent-core.outcomes.test.ts:152` (expected 2 stream calls, observed 1).
- Existing focused proof: the original SDK Agent file reproduces the failure, then passes 19/19 cases; six consumer files pass 181/181 cases. Scoped imported-graph types, type-aware lint, format, and diff checks pass.
- Independent canonical Codex autoreview: base `94ae988ecbb`, accepted head `d4d05db4cbea9161952c1d20040943d67b920dd7`, P0–P2 scoped-clean; no remaining findings. The hosted commit preserves the reviewed tree.
- Simplification: reuse the existing diagnostic catch with no new state or helper. Exact-head PR CI supplies broad proof.

Requested by @steipete
